goal: 16:9 Pseudo-Game Screen, Engine Feel Close to Recent Domestic Self-Developed MMO Gameplay, Non-Animated PV

game_meta.game_name: Journey Through the Nine Provinces: The Record of Fire Robbery.
game_meta.engine_feel: High saturation post-processing Chinese-style MMO (flying sword and lightness system)

scene.environment: Broken floating mountain stones and vermilion palace ruins, with rolling clouds beneath and distant thundercloud pillars.
scene.time_of_day: Transition from night to twilight, indigo sky light
scene.weather: Intermittent spiritual light fragments like dust
scene.lighting: Two colors of the artifact, lapis lazuli and azure, with main light crossing, figures have an outline feeling but not cel shading.

character.description: Identifiable as a middle-aged male figure with the temperament of Tim Cook: slender build, silver-gray robe, simple hairstyle, no crown, hands forming a sword stance, standing on a flying sword, with a gentle and focused expression, typical of fantasy art protagonist types rather than modern portrait face-swaps
character.position: Slightly below the center, the pressure from the enemy direction comes from the left side outside the image.

items: on top of character's head: bi-directional health bars (green for self/red for enemy) + name 'Yunwai Ke'
On the right side of the screen: vertical 1-0 skill and talisman wheel, currently highlighted 'Calamity Fire'
Lower left: chat window three lines '[World] Someone: Looking for a team' '[System] You received Spirit Stones ×3' '[Team] Captain: Focus fire'
Top right: Small map circular + directions and area name 'Xuhai·Broken Dragon Platform'

subtitle.speaker: Master's teachings
subtitle.text: The calamity fire will fall; first cut off his sword vein!

style.rendering: Digital national style thick paint texture + real-time particles, slightly higher contrast.
style.color_palette: Dark blue + vermilion + gold + electric cyan

constraints.must_keep: Chat and system text in Simplified Chinese, unified font with no garbled characters
constraints.avoid: Japanese style JRPG circular command menu mixed with Xianxia UI, health bar style overlapping with bottom-left chat
